column3: load prism.json once; sanitize settings and history (judge settings.*, history.*); settings changed while a load error was active are merged over the loaded values; history changed during the error is kept; a load error sets the message "Could not load settings: {error}. Repair prism.json, then retry. Saving is paused to preserve your file." and pauses saving; `ready` turns true when the read finishes either way; the result is ignored after unmount
column5: AppState fields `ready`, `state_load_error: Option<String>`, `settings_changed_after_load_error: SettingsPatch`, `history_changed_after_load_error: bool`, `state_read: Shared<Task<()>>` (flush awaits it). The load task applies the same merge order and the same message text. Dropping AppState drops the task.

column3: after ready: read the system theme once, then follow theme-change events
column5: After ready, `backend.get_system_theme()` once, plus the `CoreEvent::ThemeChanged` subscription (bridge listen row). Both set `system_theme`.

column3: if loading had failed: reload, re-sanitize, re-apply the changes made during the error, clear the error; a second load failure sets the same message and rethrows; then flush
column5: Same steps as a method returning `Task<Result<(), String>>`; the error text is identical to the initial-load message.

column3: clear the persist timer and every toast timer
column5: Dropping AppState drops `persist_timer` and `toast_tasks`. No explicit code.

column3: wait for the initial read; refuse while a load error is active; native first: set the default shortcut, then the default taskbar alignment; if alignment fails, roll back alignment and shortcut and throw the composed message (three message shapes: shortcut rollback failed, alignment rollback failed, plain error); on success replace settings with defaults (empty pins and groups, default quick access and section order) and schedule a save
column5: Method `reset_settings(cx) -> Task<Result<(), String>>` with the same order and the same three error strings ("Reset stopped: {e}. Shortcut restoration also failed: {r}. The shortcut remains Win.{ Taskbar restoration failed: {a}.}" ; "Reset stopped: {e}. Could not restore taskbar alignment: {a}. Select the alignment again to retry."; or the original error). When the shortcut rollback fails, settings.shortcut becomes the default.

column3: flush persistence, then quit; on error the toast "Could not quit Prism" with detail "Your changes are still open. {error}" (kind error)
column5: `quit(cx)`: await flush, then `backend.quit_app()`; Err -> the same toast.

column3: whenever `persistenceError` becomes non-empty: toast "Settings need attention" / "Open Settings to review the error and retry saving." (kind error)
column5: The setter of `persistence_error` shows the toast when the new value is Some. Same text.

column3: with the accent/theme effect: `setOsdAccent(settings.accent)`, errors ignored
column5: On accent change after ready: `backend.set_osd_accent(accent)`, result ignored. (The accent/theme row covers the Theme global.)

column3: after ready and on each effective-theme change: `setWindowStyle(theme)`; error toast "Appearance not applied" (kind error)
column5: `backend.set_window_style(theme)` for the GPUI window's HWND (prism-core keeps the native style code); Err -> same toast.

column3: on width change after ready: with no previous width, the same width, or reduced motion, set the width at once; otherwise animate from the rendered width to the target over 240 ms with ease-out cubic `1 - (1 - t)^3`, rounding to whole pixels, sending a native resize at most every 45 ms and always at the end; an error at the end shows "Window width not applied" / "Try selecting the width again. {error}" (kind error); a new width cancels the running animation
column5: `width_task: Option<Task<()>>` replaced on each change; the task steps on each frame (`window.request_animation_frame` / timer at frame rate), computes the same eased value, throttles `backend.set_window_width(px)` to 45 ms, and sends the final value. Reduced motion (the reduced-motion row) skips to the target. Same toast.

column3: after ready and on change: set the window's always-on-top; error toast "Always on top not applied" / "Toggle the setting to retry. {error}"
column5: prism-app sets the window level (GPUI `WindowKind::PopUp`/topmost, or `SetWindowPos(HWND_TOPMOST/NOTOPMOST)` through prism-core on the GPUI HWND). Same toast.
column7: needs-spike: which GPUI 0.2.2 window option toggles topmost at runtime on Windows; fallback is SetWindowPos on the raw HWND

column3: after ready and on change: `setViewZoom(percent)`, which in Tauri sets the WebView zoom factor (percent / 100); error toast "Zoom not applied" / "Choose a zoom level to retry. {error}"
column5: All UI sizes are expressed in rems (rule:classname and theme.rs), and the root sets `window.set_rem_size(BASE_REM * percent / 100)` so the whole UI scales like the WebView zoom. The window size itself does not change (WebView zoom does not resize the window). Same toast text on failure.

column3: after ready and on change: `setTaskbarScrollVolume(settings.taskbarScrollVolume ?? true)`; error toast "Taskbar volume control not applied" / "Toggle the setting to retry. {error}"
column5: `backend.set_taskbar_scroll_volume(value)` with the same default true; same toast.

column3: after ready: on `win-mode-failed` show "Win-key mode disabled" with the reason (kind error) and set the shortcut back to the default
column5: Subscription to `CoreEvent::WinModeFailed(reason)`: same toast, then `update_settings(shortcut = DEFAULT)`.
